result.competitor: I found no software or gestoría for this licence; my Spanish searches for gestoría/trámite services turned up nothing. MAGA lets applicants fill in the form in advance on its portal (VISAR en Línea, announced in 2021, and electronic procedures from August 2024). Submission, payment and inspection are still in person. MAGA also holds free regional jornadas to issue and renew licences (for example Jalapa, June 2025), which lowers the value of a done-for-you service. I did not check generic fleet-document tools.
result.duty: Guatemala requires a Licencia Sanitaria de Transporte for each vehicle, own or contracted, that moves unprocessed food of plant, animal or fish origin. MAGA (VISAR, Dirección de Inocuidad) issues it. The legal basis is Acuerdo Gubernativo 969-99 (Reglamento para la Inocuidad de los Alimentos, arts. 16 and 23). For eggs there is also Acuerdo Ministerial 263-2019, which has articles on the transport licence (15), renewal (16), sanctions (20) and validity (21), but their text is paywalled on vLex and I did not read it. The fee is US$9.75 or the quetzal equivalent, paid at Banrural (AGN, Jalapa 2025). Requirements are the application form, health card (plus lung card for eggs), driver licence, vehicle circulation card, payment receipt and a physical vehicle inspection. Licences are renewed, but I could not confirm how long one is valid or the penalty amount.
result.market: AGN reports 1,728 licences issued in Q1 2026, with a category breakdown of 999 plant, 114 fish and 415 meat that adds up to only 1,528. Press reports also mention more than 1,300 licences in early 2025 and more than 600 for poultry transport. That suggests a few thousand licensed vehicles a year, mostly small and informal operators. I found no register that gives a count of holders.
result.reason: The duty is real. AGN says the vehicle licence is mandatory, Acuerdo Ministerial 263-2019 cites Acuerdo Gubernativo 969-99 as its basis, and the licences are renewed. I found no software or gestoría that does this job. Still a weak business. The fee is only US$9.75. The vehicle has to be inspected in person, either at Inocuidad in zona 13 or at free MAGA jornadas in the departments, so there is little to automate beyond reminders and getting papers ready. Buyers are informal small hauliers and growers with little willingness to pay. Volume is modest: about 1,700 licences in Q1 2026. I could not confirm the validity period or penalties because the articles of AM 263-2019 that set them are paywalled. MAGA also runs its own VISAR en Línea forms.

result.competitor: None found specific to Guatemala. Searches in Spanish for AML software for Guatemalan notaries and obligated persons returned only law-firm advice (Novis, Consortium, Andersen) and generic foreign KYC tools (e.g. didit.me). IVE has posted instructions for registering obligated persons on its portal, and the new law gives IVE the power to run registers and IT systems, so a free state reporting channel may come. result.duty: Decreto 15-2026, art. 42 (per law-firm summaries; I could not reach the official text). Notaries must register with IVE, identify clients and keep a record with minimum data for each client, report unusual or suspicious transactions to IVE, and keep documents. Per Novis Legal, they need no prevention manual or compliance officer. Lexlatin says notaries are covered when authorizing real-estate deeds, with an exemption for defense and litigation work. Fines are USD 500 to 300,000, doubled for obstructing IVE. Reporting happens per transaction; no fixed periodic report was found. IVE regulation is due by about 17 Mar 2027, and the SIB says to comply without waiting for it. A constitutional challenge was filed, outcome not verified. The registration deadline was not found.
result.market: Not found. No official count of active notaries or CANG members turned up; the CANG 2025 annual report was found but not read. Only notaries who authorize real-estate deeds, plus lawyers who take part in covered transactions, carry the duty.
result.reason: The duty is real, but lighter than the claim says. Decreto 15-2026 was published 17 Jun 2026 and took effect around 17 Sep 2026. It makes notaries who authorize real-estate deeds obligated persons, under IVE (part of the bank supervisor SIB). Per Novis Legal, article 42 limits notaries to four duties: register with IVE, record client data, report unusual transactions, and keep documents. They need no prevention manual and no compliance officer, so the claim's written program and compliance officer don't apply to notaries. Fines run USD 500 to 300,000. I found no Guatemala-specific AML software, but IVE's coming regulation (due Mar 2027) and its own systems may supply forms. Notary count was not found. The lighter duty means lower willingness to pay.

result.duty: INAB's Reglamento de Fiscalización de Empresas Forestales and the Reglamento de la Ley Forestal require forest firms (sawmills, depots, carpentries, furniture makers, exporters) to register in the RNF, keep a record of goods in and out, and file the quarterly ITEMAS report through SEINEF. The regulation says use of the system is mandatory. Each transport of timber needs an INAB nota de envío. Firms face inspections, joint operations with the Ministerio Público and the police, and road checks (AGN, 2022). The regulation was not readable when fetched, so I could not confirm the exact current resolution or the sanctions.
result.market: About 1,300 or more firms used SEINEF in 2017 (ITTO completion report). The claim cites 1,635 registered firms from an undated Profor manual. Region VI alone had 282 active forest firms in 2022 (AGN). I found no national count for 2025 or 2026.
result.reason: The duty exists. INAB's Reglamento de Fiscalización de Empresas Forestales requires every firm that buys, stores, processes, sells, imports or exports forest products to register in the RNF, keep a record of goods in and out, file the quarterly ITEMAS report and use notas de envío for transport. But INAB's own free system, SEINEF (seinef.inab.gob.gt), already does this core job, and the regulation makes its use mandatory. In SEINEF, firms record goods in and out, keep their stock, file the quarterly report and issue electronic notas de envío around the clock. RNF registration has been online at rnf.inab.gob.gt since November 2024. That leaves only a thin layer for software to add. The market is about 1,300 to 1,600 small firms. I could not confirm that SEINEF is still running in 2026: every SEINEF source is from 2014 to 2017.

No software found, but studies need an accredited consultant plus lab tests (not recurring software work). Market size is not found. Low pain-frequency fit and legal uncertainty give a low score.
